name: What are the most common reasons garage conversion permits get delayed?

mainEntity.name: Why do garage conversion ADU permits in Los Angeles-area cities often take longer than expected?
mainEntity.text: Why do garage conversion ADU permits in Los Angeles-area cities often take longer than expected?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit delays often have less to do with the city and more to do with incomplete preparation. Garage conversion plans can stall when the submittal package is missing structural details, energy documents, site information, or a clear utility strategy. Existing conditions also create surprises, especially if the garage has been altered over time or sits close to property lines. The more questions the plan checker has to answer, the more correction cycles are likely. Homeowners can reduce delay risk by doing a thorough feasibility study, documenting existing conditions, and addressing obvious code conflicts before submission. It also helps to work with a team that has local ADU experience and knows what each city commonly flags. A well-prepared permit set is often the difference between a smooth review and months of back-and-forth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permit delays usually happen when plans are incomplete, site conditions are unclear, or utility and structural issues are not resolved before submittal. Common problems include missing engineering, unclear setbacks, code conflicts, and city correction cycles that repeat several times.
